**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/29 (Mon) 11:44  
[USER] User requested a Cisco UCS 6454 configuration.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that a full Cisco UCS 6454 configuration is complex and requires a deep understanding of networking and Cisco UCS architecture.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended having a professional network engineer with Cisco UCS experience to assist with the configuration.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided a sample configuration for a Cisco UCS 6454.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Sample configuration includes steps to configure the fabric interconnect, fabric extender, and server.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Configuration step: "Configure the fabric interconnect" includes:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Management IP address configuration: `UCS-A# scope fabric-interconnect a UCS-A /fabric-interconnect # create-mgmt-network 10.0.0.1 255.255.255.0`  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Virtual IP address configuration: `UCS-A# scope fabric-interconnect a UCS-A /fabric-interconnect # create-virtual-ip 10.0.0.100`  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - NTP server configuration: `UCS-A# scope fabric-interconnect a UCS-A /fabric-interconnect # set ntp server 1.1.1.1`  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Configuration step: "Configure the fabric extender" includes:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - FEX association with the correct Fabric Interconnect: `UCS-A# scope fabric-interconnect a UCS-A /fabric-interconnect # scope fabric-extender 101 UCS-A /fabric-interconnect/fabric-extender # associate-uplink Eth1/1`  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - VLAN configuration for FEX: `UCS-A# scope fabric-interconnect a UCS-A /fabric-interconnect # scope fabric-extender 101 UCS-A /fabric-interconnect/fabric-extender # create-vlan 100 UCS-A /fabric-interconnect/fabric-extender # set vlan 100 native`  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Configuration step: "Configure the server" includes:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Server VLAN configuration: `UCS-A# scope server 1 UCS-A /server # create-vnic vnic1 UCS-A /server/vnic # set vlan 100`  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Server IP address configuration: `UCS-A# scope server 1 UCS-A /server # create-vnic vnic1 UCS-A /server/vnic # create-adapter-profile eth0 UCS-A /server/adapter-profile # set ip 10.0.0.2 255.255.255.0`
